correctness.rationale: The face is exactly invariant; binomial log-derivative yields unique mode p and B’’(p)=-beta* n^3/(ad). This gives the rigorous critical Riccati limit t(x-p)->2/(beta*n). Exact hitting-time integral and local dominated scaling yield pi sqrt(2n/(beta* ad)). The triangular Jacobian has two negative transverse eigenvalues under explicit inequalities, furnishing a nondegenerate center fold. Verification independently checks curvature identities for 153 parameter pairs and finite-epsilon integrals for five pairs; numeric tests are not proofs.
